digest.overview: Grok 4.6 drops with Elon hype and SpaceX data plans for 4.7; DeepSeek V4 Pro hits OpenRouter API. Anthropic watermark backlash and Amazon/Twitch opt-out policy dominate discussion amid rising model competition.

top_story.headline: Grok 4.6 launches as xAI claims top spot on intelligence, speed, and cost
top_story.summary: Elon Musk announces Grok 4.6 availability with double tokens promo; teases Grok 4.7 in 3-4 weeks after supplemental SpaceX training. Latent Space calls it the biggest new AI teammate entrant.
top_story.why_it_matters: Positions xAI as closed-API competitor to OpenAI/Anthropic with unique real-world engineering data advantage; immediate claims of #1 ranking across metrics.

sentiment.label: bullish
sentiment.summary: Excitement over rapid releases and competition; Elon posts drive hype while community notes shifting vibes from Anthropic lead to multi-lab race.

model_releases.headline: DeepSeek V4 Pro 0813 now live on OpenRouter (API only)
model_releases.summary: Latest DeepSeek Pro model released via API; no open weights confirmation yet. Simon Willison flags it as the newest high-end option.

model_releases.headline: Grok 4.6 released by xAI
model_releases.summary: Smart, fast model with strong price/performance; Elon highlights objective #1 ranking on intelligence/speed/cost.

frontier_labs.headline: Anthropic adds watermarks to Claude, sparking user backlash over job/class cheating detection
frontier_labs.summary: New system flags AI use; some users call it intrusive while others defend it as necessary.

frontier_labs.headline: Amazon/Twitch defaults to training on streamer content unless users opt out
frontier_labs.summary: Policy allows GenAI improvements from user-generated streams; CPO cites low opt-in rates as reason for default.

influencer_takes.author: Elon Musk
influencer_takes.quote: Grok 4.6 is objectively #1 when considering intelligence, speed & cost
influencer_takes.context: Direct claim of leadership post-launch, paired with 4.7 SpaceX training tease

influencer_takes.author: Dwarkesh Patel
influencer_takes.quote: I'm concerned this leads to a world where no frontier model is truly my personal advocate
influencer_takes.context: Critiques Claude Constitution prioritizing Anthropic's view of humanity over individual user alignment

influencer_takes.author: Nathan Lambert
influencer_takes.quote: The vibes shifting from 'Anthropic is so far ahead' to 'model competition back to all time highs' took like 4 weeks.
influencer_takes.context: Captures rapid sentiment change amid new releases from multiple labs

research_radar.headline: ShieldFont poisons AI scrapers with nonsense while staying readable to humans
research_radar.summary: New font weaponizes web pages against training data collection without breaking human browsing.

post_ideas.hook: Elon just declared Grok 4.6 #1 on intell/speed/cost while promising 4.7 beats everyone via SpaceX data
post_ideas.draft: Grok 4.6 out now and Elon says it's objectively #1. 4.7 coming in weeks with massive SpaceX corpus that could dominate engineering tasks. xAI closing the gap fast.
post_ideas.why_viral: Direct from Elon + unique data angle creates FOMO and debate on closed vs open strategies

post_ideas.hook: Dwarkesh worried Claude is built to serve 'humanity' per Anthropic rather than the actual user sitting in front of it
post_ideas.draft: Claude's constitution puts Anthropic's definition of humanity above being your personal advocate. Once superintelligences handle voting/investing/news, whose side are they on?
post_ideas.why_viral: Aligns personal agency fears with real product policy; sparks alignment debate

post_ideas.hook: Amazon defaults Twitch streamers into AI training data unless they opt out; CPO says opt-in would get zero users
post_ideas.draft: Twitch now trains Amazon AI by default. Opt-out only because 'if this was opt-in, nobody would opt in.' Creators get no real choice.
post_ideas.why_viral: Opt-out controversy taps creator rights tension with big tech data grabs
